topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes the students and outlines the scope and approach of the lecture on inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition via PAMPs, DAMPs, and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses microbial infection and tissue damage through pattern recognition receptors and their intracellular signaling pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory cell recruitment, trafficking, and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells direct immune cell extravasation into tissues, lymphatic migration, and the systemic consequences of severe inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory states
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the mechanisms responsible for terminating acute inflammation, repairing damaged tissue, and managing unresolved chronic inflammatory conditions.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and announces the subject of the next lecture.
